Conservative V1 engineering defaults for HOW the controller may attempt an already-authorized milestone -- never WHAT is authorized (that is the milestone contract's job, never this file's). These are operational defaults chosen for a single-collaborator repository with a slow, careful human approval gate, NOT empirically proven universal values. Snapshotted (with its own content hash) into every run at initialization; changing this file later never mutates an already-running run's own snapshot.
